How the money works

Ventari is a pooled fund structure.

Every friend contributes to one shared pool for the trip. Each contribution is tracked under the person who made it, the whole crew sees the balance live, and the pool is used to book the trip the group chose together.

  1. 01Each friend contributesAny amount, at their own pace
  2. 02One pooled fundEvery contribution tracked by name
  3. 03The pool books the tripFlights + hotel for the whole crew

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Short answers about the trip, the money and booking.

Does Ventari cost anything?

No. Ventari is free to use: no sign-up fee, no subscription and no fee on the money in your pool. You only pay for the trip itself, the flights and hotel, at the live price when your crew books.

Who is Ventari for?

Friend groups of 2 to 20 friends, mostly in their 20s, who want to travel together but never get past the group chat.

What's included in a trip?

Return flights, booked directly with the airline (about 140 to choose from), and a hotel for every night. Both are priced live and booked together when your pool is ready.

How does the money work?

Ventari uses a pooled fund structure: each friend contributes to one shared pool for the trip, every contribution is tracked by name, and the pool is used to book the trip your crew picks.

Does everyone put in the same amount?

No. Each friend sets their own budget and adds money when they can.

What if the price goes up or down?

If it goes up, you'll see the exact difference and can pay it to book, or pick another date or trip. If it goes down, the difference stays in your buffer wallet as spending money.

How long is a trip held?

15 minutes. When the clock hits zero, the hold is released.

Can we pick our own destination?

Yes. Start an open pool, heart trips together, and choose when the pool is full.

Where are the exclusive trips?

Member-only deals are offered through MWR Life Travel, our travel membership partner.
